scientific_integrity: The arbitrary-algebra theorem has a self-contained proof using essential socles, free-module rigidity, and group centralizers. Finite computations are supplementary only. Closest prior specialization is acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Only finite commutative local Artinian Gorenstein algebras with residue field exactly F_q, and saturated rank fibers, are covered; no lower-rank fiber or scheme structure is asserted. Independent audit and absolute bibliographic uniqueness are not established.
title: Universal saturated socle fibers for finite local Gorenstein algebras
